# Create Stack

Create Stack generates a SaaS project from your choices. It supports Next.js and TanStack Start.
Database, authentication, email, and other infrastructure capabilities use replaceable providers.

Start with `pnpm dlx @alfredmouelle/create-stack@latest my-app`.

Repository: https://github.com/alfredmouelle/create-stack
Inspired by create-t3-app by Theo Browne.
